reply_text:
㊥ (progress) Since about 23:00, six compiler fixes have been merged into cand-1, now at `e251cb68`: panic, `EST.Out`, optParam, field notation, null receiver, and term[_] shapes A+B together. Each passed cold acceptance: its target rows got past their stop and the controls matched Lean. No new row has become fully correct yet. What has changed is that rows reach later stops. An integration check of all six merged together has the first control done and matching; the other three are still running.

㊢ (what moved)
- **Null receiver** (codex-4): `nodeFn` and `atomicFn` now get past the `null.stackSize`/`null.pos` stop. On the chart, that group fell from 11 to 3, once codex-4's warm re-probes of the other rows were recorded.
- **term[_] A+B** (codex-18 and codex-24): `List.foldlM`, `updateLeading` and `mkUnexpectedError` get past the coercion and `do_lift` stops, then stop at shape C (the ``` ``(…) ``` quotation inside `withAnnotateTerm`). codex-24 starts on C next.
- **Field notation** (codex-29): `crlfToLf` gets past its stop and reaches the `let_mvar` name clash. codex-18's macro-scope fix is aimed at that clash.
- **panic, `EST.Out`, optParam** (codex-25, codex-27, codex-28): each moved one row one stop further on.

㊩ (the chart) The term[_] bar has gone up, to 50 rows. That's because the null-receiver rows moved onto the term[_] stop, and most term[_] rows haven't been re-probed since A+B merged. The chart will lag until C lands and those rows are re-probed.

㊩ (what went wrong)
- **binrel:** codex-18 failed five times in a row the same way, so I paused it. claude-3 then found the real cause: the port has no type for `Ne`, because Lean's `def Ne … := ¬(a = b)` has no written result type. codex-29 is now fixing that in general (`psw/deftype`).
- **Numerals:** codex-19's first fix broke `Array.extract`. Cold acceptance caught it before merging. The rework matches warm and is now in cold acceptance.
- **Macro scopes:** codex-18's first fix passed its own test while the defect was still there. The test exercised only one macro runtime, and production uses two. The rework uses one shared scope supply and a two-runtime test.
- **My mistakes:** I quoted the `nomatch` error without its quote marks, which cost one 12-minute rerun. And one merge conflict needed resolving: I kept codex-28's accepted optParam code over an older version of the same binder logic carried on the A+B branch.

㊢ (in flight)
- **Cold acceptance running:** host parsers (codex-17), numerals (codex-19), nomatch (codex-25).
- **Fixes being written or reworked:** type projection (codex-27), let binding (codex-28), def result type (codex-29), macro scopes (codex-18).
- **Discovery / tooling:** C is next for codex-24. codex-23's term-capture tool for the Lean-trace comparator is still with codex-23.
- **Rob's main:** codex-4 merges cand-1 into the Rob merge branch next, then runs the 20-row cold acceptance. I'll come back to you before anything is pushed to Rob's main.

㊟ (speed) The machine has been running at a load average around 24. A cold control row that took about 25 minutes earlier took 66 minutes in the integration check, so acceptance is now the slowest part of the cycle. The six pool worktrees removed most of the per-packet setup time, but cold runs remain slow while this many run at once.
